name: Multi-pass Projection Voxelization
definition: The first step of the voxelization algorithm, voxelize all remaining surface primitives after culling to produce an initial 'incorrect' surface voxelization that includes hidden primitives, used later as a barrier for flood fill.
summary: Multi-pass Projection Voxelization projects primitives along multiple orthogonal directions and composites the results to prevent rasterization failures on perpendicular surfaces.
